name: Ticket

fields.name: title
fields.description: Brief summary of the ticket issue

fields.name: description
fields.description: Detailed description of the issue or request

fields.name: status
fields.description: Current ticket status: new, assigned, in-progress, or resolved

fields.name: priority
fields.description: Priority level: low, medium, or high

fields.name: category
fields.description: Ticket category or type for classification

fields.name: customerId
fields.description: Reference to the customer who submitted the ticket

fields.name: assignedAgentId
fields.description: Reference to the support agent assigned to the ticket

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the ticket was created

fields.name: updatedAt
fields.description: Timestamp of the last ticket update

description: Central data model capturing ticket details from submission through resolution with status tracking and assignment information

name: User

fields.name: email
fields.description: User's email address for login and communication

fields.name: role
fields.description: User role: customer, agent, or manager

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Indicates if the user account is active

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the user account was created

constraints.role: Must be one of: customer, agent, manager
constraints.email: Must be valid email format and unique

description: Store user profiles for customers, agents, and managers with role-based access and contact information
